title: Ganon's Castle (Ganondorf): adult Link in the dungeon, boss key, 8 hearts
notes: Link loads in the dungeon (InsideGanonCastle), not the boss rush room GanondorfStage (a free-play warp into a rush room left both games black with no control; the Gohma preset goes through the dungeon too).

Link is put at the boss room's arrival point (docs/dungeons-boss.md, the eight rooms: the same coordinates as the rush start 0.01 171.05 -11.31). A place skips the door's own trigger, so the intro may not run from here: if no boss comes, walk out of the room through its door and in again (`look` lists the doors). The place before the door is not in the repository; the first lane run records it.
The age is set before the warp (Sequence_IsChildhood, then 30 frames), so a save of either age works.

The boss is made alive as docs/dungeons-boss.md (the boss set table) has it: the shared quest Defeat_Ganon is put back to its step Step05, and the boss room's played flags (the intro and the death among them) and Bools to their before values.
